h1: November Garden Pool Villa Chai Nat — a freshly renovated private pool villa in the rice fields
intro: If you want a place in Chai Nat with a pool all to yourself, where you wake up to rice fields and mountain views with no towers in sight — November Garden Pool Villa Chainat is the name people keep mentioning. It's a freshly renovated boutique pool villa in Ban Bung Hak Kong Sin, Mueang Chai Nat. The hook is a private outdoor pool and a genuinely peaceful rice-field setting, plus an in-villa kitchen and a BBQ area — ideal for families or groups of friends who want to book the whole house. Rates start at about ฿1,200/night for the smallest villa. The trade-off is the out-of-town location: you really need your own car here.

body.html: What sets November Garden apart from most stays in Chai Nat is that it's a genuinely private pool villa, not a row of hotel rooms. The villa sits in the middle of the rice fields in Ban Bung Hak Kong Sin, about 4–5 km from the town centre, with mountain views and a quiet you rarely get at an ordinary hotel. The main draw is the private outdoor pool with a pool bar and a kids' pool, so children can splash about without sharing the water with other guests.

The property has been freshly renovated, and guests consistently say everything looks new and spotlessly clean. Rooms come with a terrace, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a water heater and hair dryer, and some units have a fully equipped kitchen so you can cook for yourselves. There's a range of sizes, from a small one-bedroom villa up to larger three- to five-bedroom houses that sleep around 10–12 — great for big families or groups who want the whole place to themselves.

Eating in is easy. There's a poolside BBQ area for your own cook-out, a small on-site bar, and an à la carte breakfast. On top of that there are free bikes for riding around the fields, free private parking, free Wi-Fi throughout, and hosts whom many guests describe as kind and genuinely helpful, sorting out requests in a warm, personal way.

"Felt like a hidden gem out in the rice fields — spotless room, the pool was well kept, the owner was so kind, and the views all around are fields and mountains. Wonderfully peaceful, perfect for a family getaway."

To be straight with you, the limitation guests mention most is the remote location and the need for a car. The villa is out among the fields, with no restaurants or convenience stores within walking distance, so it's awkward without your own transport. Many people get around this by ordering delivery or buying supplies in town beforehand — which fits nicely with having a kitchen and BBQ on hand.

A few smaller details aren't perfect either. Some reviews note that the beds are quite firm, and that a couple of bathrooms have no curtain or proper shower enclosure, so water can splash around. Occasionally the pool hasn't been fully tended to at check-in, so it's worth messaging the host ahead if you're a big group or want to use the pool the moment you arrive. Bookings here are also non-refundable on several platforms, so lock in your dates before you confirm.

Overall, November Garden Pool Villa scores a high 9.0 out of 10 from real guest reviews (around 48 of them, with some recent stays rating it as high as 9.5). It's a pool villa that lands well for anyone who wants privacy, a pool of their own and a quiet rice-field setting in Chai Nat, on a budget that starts around ฿1,200 for the small villa and climbs into the thousands if you book a larger house. If you have a car and want to escape the bustle with your family or friends, it offers something the town's tower hotels simply can't.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — November Garden Pool Villa Chai Nat

faq.q: Where in Chai Nat is November Garden Pool Villa, and what's nearby?
faq.a: November Garden is at 399 Moo 5, Soi 10, Ban Bung Hak Kong Sin, Thammamun, Mueang Chai Nat. It sits among quiet rice fields about 4–5 km from Chai Nat town (a 10–12 minute drive). It's close to Wat Thammamun Worawihan and Wat Pak Khlong Makham Thao, and Uthai Thani town is about a 20-minute drive away.

faq.q: How much does November Garden Pool Villa cost, and what villa types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿1,200/night for the small one-bedroom villa. Sizes range from one bedroom up to larger three- to five-bedroom houses. Book the whole house and it sleeps around 10–12, with rates climbing into the thousands per night. Always compare across platforms before booking — and note that many rates here are non-refundable.

faq.q: Does November Garden Pool Villa have a private pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's a private outdoor pool with a pool bar and a kids' pool, plus free on-site parking. The privacy of the pool is something many families love, since children can swim without sharing the water with other guests.

faq.q: Who is November Garden Pool Villa best for, and can you visit without a car?
faq.a: It's ideal for families or groups of friends who want to book a whole pool villa and enjoy privacy and a quiet rice-field setting. But it's well out of town with no shops nearby, so you really want your own car. Without one, getting around is awkward — consider an in-town stay like Chaophayathara Riverside or Nara Premium instead.

faq.q: Does November Garden Pool Villa have a kitchen and BBQ?
faq.a: Yes. Some villas have a fully equipped in-villa kitchen, and there's a poolside BBQ area. It's worth buying fresh food and grilling supplies in Chai Nat town before you arrive, as there are no convenience stores nearby. There's also an à la carte breakfast available.

faq.q: What are the rooms at November Garden Pool Villa like — are they clean?
faq.a: The property has been freshly renovated, so guests consistently say everything looks new and spotlessly clean, with a terrace, air conditioning, flat-screen TV and private bathroom. The things to keep in mind: some reviews mention the beds are quite firm, and a couple of bathrooms have no curtain or proper shower enclosure, so water can splash around.
